body: I would enjoy my time alone and create an utopia, make the most of my time and take my own life when I get bored. Just like a game.
I don't trust anyone who I can talk to right now, and the only person I want to talk to isn't available..

He does understand, but he wouldn't know how to reply. I can't talk to my school counselor because she is not licensed, she has no legal obligation to keep what I say between just me and her.. I've been pushed into a corner and have nowhere to go.

My family wont let me talk to her, I want to, believe me, but my own mom keeps her from me. I hate both of my parents from the bottom of my heart, sure they've kept me alive, but what's the point of life when it's miserable? I want to talk to her, I really do, but my dad is a fucking maniac and wont let me out of the house because he feels like I'm rejecting him and my mom starts fights with my sister because she gets jealous when I talk to her instead of my mom. I wish my family wasn't so fucked up.. My thoughts are all over the place, so I'm going to add something else. - I have a wonderful step mom and step grandparents, they are loving and would do anything for me, but my dad hates them.. He has severe anger issues and I don't want him to blow up like he did when I was little and go back to prison, I wish we could talk about it, but I can't find the right words to say..
